bootloaders.name: GOHO Bootloader
bootloaders.sourceRevision: 499098d5863c0ee8564df78c5f2c9370775459b6 + uncommitted GOHO U2 ROM DFU changes
bootloaders.notes: Duo virtual-disk updater remains on OTG_HS PB14/PB15. Consumes Bennu U2 one-shot request and hands off to the STM32H743 system-memory ROM at 0x1FF09800 before GOHO peripheral initialization. Native ROM DFU uses OTG_FS PA11/PA12. H743 clean build; physical handoff and DFU transfer not tested.
